what_happened.line: The School Committee approved a year-end set of line-item transfers by roll call, all five yes.
The business manager said the funding came from surplus in teacher, custodial, special education transportation and out-of-district tuition accounts.
The superintendent announced the middle high school principal will remain in a permanent combined role, and the facilities director position will be posted.
The committee accepted the Keystone Collaborative quarterly update by roll call, all yes.
The Finance Committee report questioned the primary school air conditioning figure in the capital plan; an engineer peer review is planned before Town Meeting.

why_it_matters: The transfers show which school accounts ended the year with unspent money and which lines needed it, which bears on how next year's budget lines are set.
The air conditioning figure is a capital plan item residents may be asked to vote on at Town Meeting, and its cost is under review.
